item.title: fix: report the real session store path in health (#124102)
item.summary: fix: report the real session store path in health (#124102) * fix(health): report the real session store path * test(sessions): complete cleanup summary fixture * test(status): cover physical session stores * test(gateway): isolate session store path coverage * test(gateway): preserve store RPC formatting * test(gateway): drop the stale sessions.list path assertion sessions.list now reports the physical SQLite store, so this assertion still expected the logical locator and failed. The dedicated server.sessions.store-paths test already asserts sessions.list and sessions.patch return the resolved database path, so this is duplicate coverage rather than a gap.
